title: Consumer Protection Law, 5741-1981
source_id: Sefer HaChukim 5741 (ס״ח תשמ״א), p 248 (the page's citation boxes also reference ס״ח תשמ״א, 298); Wikisource page: חוק הגנת הצרכן
verified_how: Fetched the Wikisource page and its raw wikitext. Page title is exactly חוק הגנת הצרכן; heading prints חוק הגנת הצרכן, התשמ״א–1981. Header citation box reads {{ח:תיבה|ס״ח תשמ״א, 248|חוק הגנת הצרכן|https://fs.knesset.gov.il/9/law/9_lsr_209363.pdf}}. Highest-year amendment box is ס״ח תשפ״ו, 368, the Economic Programme Law (Legislative Amendments for Implementing Economic Policy for Budget Year 2026), https://fs.knesset.gov.il/25/law/25_lsr_12224370.pdf — i.e. amended within the current Hebrew year, which is strong evidence of currency. The page also records a Yalkut HaPirsumim declaration prohibiting the exercise of unfair influence in a state of emergency (י״פ תשפ״ה, 2694), effective 13 January 2025 to 26 February 2025 — a spent temporary declaration, noted so an encoder does not mistake it for standing law.
notes: The general consumer statute: deception and unfair influence, disclosure, distance and door-to-door selling, cancellation rights, and the enforcement powers of the Consumer Protection and Fair Trade Authority. Partial future commencement, which matters for an as-at date: s 16ד (recording of service calls) takes effect only on 22 March 2027, and the amended definition of בנק הדואר takes effect on the determining date for the Postal Law (Amendment No 11), 31 December 2026. Both appear in the consolidated text already marked with future dates, so an encoder must pin a commencement date rather than reading the page as today's law.
